title: Proof of the Tavakoli-Morelli Schmidt-number conjectures (machine-checked in Lean 4)
description: Proof of Conjectures 2 and 3 of A. Tavakoli and S. Morelli (Phys. Rev. A 110, 062417 (2024)): tight trace-norm bounds on joint-probability matrices from incomplete sets of mutually unbiased bases and from equiangular measurements, for states of bounded Schmidt number. Both theorems are formalised in Lean 4 with Mathlib using only the standard axioms. The repository contains the proof, the Lean project, numerical checks and verification logs.
